lines.text: Daisy the spotted fawn skipped through the spring meadow alongside her watchful mother!
A sparkly turquoise butterfly fluttered past, dancing from daisy to bluebell flower!
Daisy chased the fluttery wings, leaping over logs and deeper into the unfamiliar woods!
When the butterfly flew away, Daisy looked around—the trees were tall, dark, and strange!
Mama! she cried, her little heart thumping like a drum! She couldn't see the herd!
Remembering safety rules, Daisy stopped moving, stayed by a big oak, and called out loud!
Mama Deer heard her voice, dashed through the thicket, and nuzzled her baby safe and warm!
Always hold hands in big crowds and stay where parents can clearly see your face!
Stay safe and smart—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
